correctness.rationale: Stationarity against arbitrary antiderivatives of x and y proves the conditional laws E[y|x]=0 and E[z|y]=0. Therefore E[y]=E[z]=E[xy]=E[yz]=0. The exact generator identity L(xy)=y^2+xz and stationarity of z then give E[xz]=-a and E[y^2]=a. For a<0 this is impossible. For a=0, y=0 almost surely; invariant-support tangency forces z=0, and the remaining line is exactly equilibria. For a>0, the variance, covariance, Cauchy–Schwarz bound, and two-sided y-mass follow directly. The packaged checker verifies all nonstandard algebra.

originality.rationale: The complete foundational article was inspected and gives the exact NE6 equations, source parameter, Lyapunov data, and period-doubling diagram, but targeted full-text searches found no invariant-measure, average, moment, variance, or mean-square statement. The full accessible fractional-order follow-up explicitly identifies its integer-order starting system as NE6 and focuses on fractional simulation and chaos tests rather than integer-order stationary statistics. A 2022 mathematical jerk-system paper cites the source and is classified under MSC 34C28; searches of its accessible full text found no invariant-measure, stationary, mean-square, or moment formulation. Nine semantic-index searches over direct and equivalent formulations returned only distinct-system analogues.
residual_risks: The stationary identities are short polynomial consequences, so an incidental unindexed observation could escape title/abstract and semantic searches.
The later jerk-system literature is large; the checks targeted the exact NE6 object and implication-level aliases rather than claiming exhaustive inspection of every citing paper.
The fractional-order follow-up uses an equivalent constant-term sign convention, so parameter signs must be translated before comparing formulas.
The novelty claim excludes the known absence of equilibria for nonzero forcing, the numerical Lyapunov data, and the known period-doubling diagram.

value.rationale: NE6 was introduced precisely because it supports chaotic motion without equilibria, so local equilibrium-based tools are unavailable. The exact law E[y^2]=a gives the constant term a direct global stationary meaning: it is the squared RMS velocity of every compact recurrent statistical state. The same balance creates a sharp qualitative boundary—negative forcing forbids compact stationary recurrence altogether, while zero forcing collapses all such measures to the equilibrium line—and fixes a nontrivial negative x-z covariance for positive forcing. These are natural, parameter-wide structural constraints and exact diagnostics for a benchmark hidden-attractor flow, not a numerical recomputation or arbitrary slice.
